beats.summary: Michael reveals that Luke is his nephew, admitting to nepotism in the office.

evidence.snippet: Michael: No. No, Toby. He's not. Yes he is. He's my nephew.

beats.summary: Office members debate the fairness and implications of Michael hiring his nephew Luke.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: Michael, that's nepotism. Luke is getting special treatment because he's your nephew.
Darryl: What's wrong with a level playing field?

beats.summary: Michael tries to justify nepotism by comparing it to God hiring Jesus and defends Luke despite his poor performance.

evidence.snippet: Michael: God, when he needed help on Earth, who did he hire? Jesus Christ, his son.

beats.summary: Luke is found to have neglected work duties, causing tension and concern among office staff.

evidence.snippet: Angela: I came down here to feed the feral cats like I usually do and I found something unsavory in the back of your nephew's car.
Phyllis: Well, take a look. It's all the packages he was supposed to overnight. He never bothered to send them.

beats.summary: Jo confronts Michael about Luke's poor work and warns him he will be held accountable if he keeps Luke employed.

evidence.snippet: Jo: If you keep him, Michael, I'm gonna hold you accountable for him.
Michael: I will cover his ass like moss on a Mississippi tree stump.

beats.summary: Michael describes his working relationship with Luke as one of constant pushing and mutual challenge.
